context: Tests whether the tidy skill dispatches three parallel audit agents, classifies findings by severity, applies one fix per commit with tidy: prefix, avoids code file changes, and uses AskUserQuestion for finding selection.

checklist.name: Parallel agents
checklist.description: Three parallel Explore agents are dispatched in a single message with run_in_background

checklist.name: Severity classification
checklist.description: Findings are classified by severity: must-fix, should-fix, or nice-to-have

checklist.name: One fix per commit
checklist.description: Each documentation fix gets its own git commit with a message starting with tidy:

checklist.name: No code changes
checklist.description: Only documentation files are modified, not source code files

checklist.name: User selection
checklist.description: AskUserQuestion is used to let the user choose which findings to address
